period.description: Interval (in milliseconds) between snapshots of wait events. Lower values provide higher resolution but increase overhead.

max_samples.description: Maximum number of wait event samples to retain per backend session. Larger values preserve more historical data but increase memory usage.

include_names.description: Whether to include human-readable wait event names in the collected statistics.

monitored_categories.description: List of wait event categories to monitor (e.g., 'Activity', 'IO', 'Lock', 'LWLock', 'BufferPin', 'Extension'). Leave empty to monitor all categories.

top_n.description: Number of top wait events (per category and backend) to record in detailed snapshots.
